meaning: When a flower opens and shows its colors.
mean_say: when a flower opens and shows its colors.
example: The roses bloom in early spring.
ex_say: The roses bloom in early spring.
note: One syllable. A long "oo", like in "room".
note_say: It's just one syllable, with a long oo sound, like in room.
tip: It's also a noun: "in full bloom" means all the flowers are open.
tip_say: It's also a noun. In full bloom means all the flowers are open.
vn_tip: Đọc rõ cụm /bl/ ở đầu: “blum”, đừng thành “bơ-lum”.
vn_tip_say: Say the B and L together at the start: bloom, not buh-loom.
scene: A pink flower in a pot slowly opens its petals in the sunshine while bees and petals drift by.
